title: AfterMath 2026
description:
AfterMath is the flagship 24-hour hackathon by KJSCE ACM Student Chapter — a post-apocalyptic, sustainability-focused challenge centered on building solutions for humanity.

Theme: 'The Regeneration Arc'

Tracks:
• Humanity
• Civic Innovation

Prize Pool: ₹1 Lakh+

Bring discipline. Bring code. Build what survives the collapse.

For more details, visit: https://kjsce.acm.org/aftermath
statusMessage: The flagship 24-hour hackathon by KJSCE ACM Student Chapter has concluded. We hope you enjoyed the journey into sustainability-focused innovation.
aboutLead: AfterMath 2026 brought developers, designers, and visionaries together to imagine resilient infrastructure for the real world.
aboutDetails: The 'Regeneration Arc' challenged teams to confront resource scarcity, crisis recovery, and civic sustainability by writing software and engineering prototypes designed to withstand extreme systemic pressure.
focusText:
A challenge centered on rebuilding essential systems with resilience, adaptability, and long-term sustainability in mind.

Participants explored renewable systems, circular economies, crisis response, and future habitats through practical solutions built for real communities.
quote: BUILD WHAT LASTS WHEN OLD SYSTEMS FAIL.

title: Artemis 2025
description:
Artemis, brought to you by KJSSE ACM Student Chapter, is a fun and dynamic frontend mini-hackathon. It's all about unleashing your creativity in web development—crafting cool designs, building functional frontends, and tackling unique challenges. Whether you're a pro or just starting out, it's a great chance to learn, create, and win!

For more details, visit: https://artemis.kjsce.hosting.acm.org
statusMessage: Artemis 2025 brought creative designers and developers together for an intense day of UI/UX innovation and frontend craft.
aboutLead: Artemis 2025 gave participants an immersive arena to unleash visual creativity and rapid interface engineering.
aboutDetails: From micro-interactions and smooth motion to pixel-perfect responsive layouts, designers and developers built standout web applications.
focusText:
Artemis challenges participants to bridge the gap between creative visual design and responsive code.

Participants explored modern design systems, fluid animations, and real-time frontend performance.

title: Beyond the Classroom
description:
We are the ACM Student Chapter- KJSCE’s official arm of the world’s largest computing society.

This September, we bring back our signature seminar:

✨ BEYOND THE CLASSROOM ✨

An event designed to show you what truly sets achievers apart- how to build skills, mindset, and (international) credibility beyond academics.

📝 Learn how to stand out beyond your grades
🎓 Hear from those who’ve walked the path
📰 Unlock the blueprint for success

Freshers, this is where it begins. Your network, your mentors, and maybe even your future teammates are waiting for you here ‼️
photoCaption: Beyond the Classroom 2025 · The Core Chapter
statusMessage: Beyond the Classroom 2025 connected incoming students with seasoned mentors, industry leaders, and technical innovators.
aboutLead: Beyond the Classroom demystified the roadmap for engineering freshers striving for excellence.
aboutDetails: Keynotes highlighted actionable insights on balancing university coursework with open-source development, tech teams, competitive programming, and high-impact hackathons.
focusText:
A dedicated roadmap session designed to give early engineers unfair advantages.

Students explored networking strategies, mentorship opportunities, and the mindset needed to build credibility on national and global stages.

title: Escape Sequence
description: Think fast, solve faster! KJSCE ACM presents Escape Sequence, THE high-stakes tech escape room where logic, problem-solving, and speed are your keys to victory.
statusMessage: Escape Sequence pushed problem-solving boundaries as teams deciphered cryptography, algorithms, and logic traps.
aboutLead: Escape Sequence combined the adrenaline of a traditional escape room with programming riddles and algorithmic ciphers.
aboutDetails: Teams solved multi-stage challenges under high pressure, proving that fast logic and team synergy are unstoppable.
focusText:
A multi-stage escape room where participants tackled cryptography, algorithmic hints, and speed challenges.

Only the most disciplined teams solved the sequences before the timer expired.

title: Into the Webverse
description: KJSCE-ACM is bringing you the exclusive Web Development Masterclass to help you get your much needed head-start in the world of programming! Don't just watch - code along!
photoCaption: Into the Webverse · Live Interactive Session
statusMessage: An immersive masterclass helping aspiring developers launch their web development journey with hands-on practice.
aboutLead: A code-along workshop taking beginners through the fundamentals of modern web development.
aboutDetails: From structuring markup and styling dynamic interfaces to handling state and publishing live apps, participants built side-by-side with mentors.
focusText:
Hands-on instruction covering modern web technologies, responsive layouts, Git workflows, and deployment best practices.

Designed to transform conceptual interest into working software.

title: Beyond the Classroom
description:
BEYOND THE CLASSROOM, organized by the KJSCE ACM Student Chapter, is a dedicated event for first-year engineering students.

It offers guidance on balancing academics with extracurriculars, joining tech teams, resume building, and provides introductions to web development, hackathons, competitive programming, Git and GitHub.

This event is designed to prepare freshers for a successful and well-rounded college experience!
statusMessage: Guiding first-year engineers towards balancing academics, technical teams, open-source, and competitive programming.
aboutLead: A signature orientation seminar empowering freshers with essential technical and extracurricular strategies.
aboutDetails: Senior members shared practical advice on project portfolios, campus tech teams, resume building, and international hackathon participation.
focusText:
Practical insights on balancing academics with technical clubs, open source, hackathons, and resume building.

Helping students chart ambitious technical pathways from day one.
